findings.problem: The CLI PHP 8.5 ships without the dom/xml/xmlwriter/sqlite3/pdo_sqlite extensions, so `php artisan test` only runs after pointing PHP_INI_SCAN_DIR at manually extracted .so files (as the FEAT findings documented). This is an environment gap, not a code defect — once the extensions are loaded all 17 Court tests pass.
findings.fix: Install php8.5-xml and php8.5-sqlite3 (and php8.5-gd so feature tests can use UploadedFile::fake()->image()) on the CI/dev host for a clean, repeatable gate. No code change required.
